title: My Good Boy Hypno Series Companion Audio (Standard)
description: This is an audio loop where I moan trigger words from "My Good Boy Series". I was playing around on audacity and made a moaning track of me saying 'Good Boy' to play with the triggers I've been putting in your mind. Then I played with it some more and gave it layers and binaurals... If my triggers are properly in you, you will feel amazing listening to it. Instructions You can listen to it for however long you like. It isn't really meant for everyone to listen to it in its entirety — five minutes should be enough for a casual reward — and in future files I may direct you to listen to it for varying amounts of time if I think you've been good. Enjoy, and let me know what you think or experience. This is purely experimental, but if it seems to be effective and well received I will likely make similar companion pieces in my future series.
author: Mistress Shibby
